system.description:
A Protean subclass for unseen movement and decisive strikes.

Foundation - Ghost Strike: When you succeed on an attack with advantage or while Shrouded, spend a Hope to add Tier d6s to the damage roll.

Specialization - Tactical Cloak: Mark a Stress to become Shrouded at any time until you roll with Fear or the scene ends.

Mastery - Vanishing Point: Once per rest, when an attack would hit you, mark 2 Stress to become Shrouded, teleport within Far range, and cause the attack to miss.
